note: Decision 366: what an enemy notices in exploration rounds. Each bestiary entry may override any of these in its own `awareness`; an enemy never turned on the map looks all round.

links.name: Alone
links.text: Sees with his own eyes. To warn the others he has to shout, run or radio.

links.name: Squad
links.text: Linked to his group: what one sees, the group knows at once.

links.name: Network
links.text: On the site's network: his group knows at once, and the site's alert rises.

fields.cone: Field of view, degrees (360 = all round)
fields.ears: Hears a full-pace move up to, squares
fields.dark: Sees in the dark up to, squares (night vision)
fields.thermal: Thermal up to, squares (warm bodies in the dark and smoke)
fields.motion: Motion tracker up to, squares (through walls)

stealth.note: Decision 367: stealth in exploration rounds. Sneak = half Move (at least 1). Unseen / exposed (a Stealth roll, or Shadow) / caught (lit, in their eyes, this close or closer). Shadow = base + margin × perMargin, at most max; an exposure costs light (dark, far, along half cover) or heavy (close, lit, a full-pace move).

goggles.note: Decision 369: goggles are personal - each wearer has their own layer on their map (shared between Tac-Mesh AR wearers): night vision a green wash on the dark squares it reaches, thermal heat (glass stops it), a motion tracker blips (whatever moved lately, give or take a square, through walls).

glare.note: Decision 371: a torch beam or a flare on a night-vision wearer washes it out while the light is on them (players lose their night layer; an enemy sees nothing but thermal).

trackerTrace.note: Decision 371: each Resolve a player has a motion tracker on, with an enemy on the network on the map, the site alert gets +1.
